# TinyMCE 6 community translations

Source: https://download.tiny.cloud/tinymce/community/languagepacks/6/langs.zip

Downloaded 2026-10-24 for TinyMCE 6.8.2. Files are preserved as distributed by Tiny.
Only the eight non-English languages supported by the administration interface are included.
English is built into TinyMCE. Do not substitute TinyMCE 8 language packs; its language codes differ.
